detailed_descriptions.en: Unlock the full Asobi Remote Play experience with Asobi Premium with features such as, • Full controller support such as haptics and gyro • Full 1:1 adaptive trigger support when using a DualSense controller • Low-latency modes • Manual bitrate control • Up to 1080p / 60 fps / HDR Remote Play streaming • Up to 4K native / 60 fps / HDR PS Cloud streaming • Up to 4K upscaling on supported displays • Up to 120 fps output via frame generation on supported monitors • Realtime 2D to 3D conversion with four modes: Full SBS, Half SBS Red/Cyan and Magenta/Green • 16 screen filters, including Vivid, Monochrome, Cell Shaded and 32-bit modes, to add more variety to your gameplay • Audio delay and behaviour settings • Zoom & Pan for a full-screen experience • Ambient light spill mode • On-screen lightbar-style status indicator • On-device gyro input support • On-device haptic feedback

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Unlock the full Asobi Remote Play experience with Asobi Premium with features such as,

• Full controller support such as haptics and gyro
• Full 1:1 adaptive trigger support when using a DualSense controller
• Low-latency modes
• Manual bitrate control
• Up to 1080p / 60 fps / HDR Remote Play streaming
• Up to 4K native / 60 fps / HDR PS Cloud streaming
• Up to 4K upscaling on supported displays
• Up to 120 fps output via frame generation on supported monitors
• Realtime 2D to 3D conversion with four modes: Full SBS, Half SBS Red/Cyan and Magenta/Green
• 16 screen filters, including Vivid, Monochrome, Cell Shaded and 32-bit modes, to add more variety to your gameplay
• Audio delay and behaviour settings
• Zoom & Pan for a full-screen experience
• Ambient light spill mode
• On-screen lightbar-style status indicator
• On-device gyro input support
• On-device haptic feedback
